title: Memoized Fibonacci: O(n) time for O(n) space

cases.says: fib(0) is 0, fib(1) is 1, fib(10) is 55, fib(20) is 6765, and a negative n is refused.

fib(25) stores each of its subproblems in the memo once (at most 26 puts, where plain recursion makes over 240,000 calls), and fib(50) and fib(90) come back at once: 12586269025 and 2880067194370816120.
After fib(40, memo), fib(41, memo) with the same memo adds just one entry.
fib(92) fits in a long, fib(93) does not and is refused with ArithmeticException instead of wrapping around.
